heading: Tuesday, June 17, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and Moonshot AI Kimi-Dev-72B.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite; 2.5 Pro and Flash reach GA
items.summary: Google made Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash stable and generally available, and released Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite in preview as its fastest and most cost-efficient 2.5 model, with adjustable thinking and a 1M-token context window.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi-Dev-72B coding model
items.summary: Kimi-Dev-72B is an open-weight software-engineering model optimized with large-scale reinforcement learning on real repositories. Moonshot reports 60.4% on SWE-bench Verified, which it described as a new state of the art among open-source models at release.
